stories.title: Vikings WR Jauan Jennings on rebuffing return to 49ers: 'I love where I'm at'
stories.summary: Jauan Jennings said he rebuffed the chance to return to the 49ers via trade despite struggling to produce for the Vikings because "I love where I'm at."
stories.detail: EAGAN, Minn. -- Jauan Jennings explained Saturday why he voiced a desire to remain with the Minnesota Vikings earlier this season, despite a steep production decline, as the team discussed a trade that would have returned him to the San Francisco 49ers , where he played the first six seasons of his career. "I just thought it was best for both teams," Jennings told ESPN. "No distractions. I love where I'm at." Jennings, who signed a one-year, $8 million contract with the Vikings in June, will miss Monday night's game against the Buffalo Bills because of a strained calf that he suffered in practice this week. He missed a game in Week 2 while grieving the death of a family member, but in six appearances this season he has only 10 targets on 145 routes run. He has caught six of those passes for 54 yards, his lowest totals through eight weeks of a season since he was a part-time player with the 49ers in 2021. Much of that can be explained by the Vikings' intention to maximize targets to receivers Justin Jefferson and Jordan Addison , as well as their use of tight end T.J. stories.title: Falcons activate James Pearce, Yasir Abdullah
stories.summary: Falcons linebacker James Pearce is set to make his 2026 debut.
stories.detail: Falcons linebacker James Pearce is set to make his 2026 debut. Pearce was suspended for the first eight games of the season as a result of a domestic violence arrest and the team officially moved him to their active roster on Saturday. Pearce had 10.5 sacks as a rookie and he'll try to add to that total against Joe Burrow and the Bengals in Madrid on Sunday. The Falcons also activated Yasir Abdullah from injured reserve, so they'll have a couple of new options on the edge this weekend. Wide receiver Beaux Collins came off of injured reserve as well and the Falcons signed running back Khalil Herbert off of the practice squad. He's filled in for the injured Brian Robinson the last couple of weeks and will remain in that role with Robinson going on injured reserve due to a hamstring issue. Defensive lineman Drake Jackson was elevated from the practice squad to round out the day's moves.

stories.title: Browns, Saints Week 9: Home team’s roster gets 2 big reinforcements, 6 roster moves
stories.summary: The Cleveland Browns work is more difficult in Week 9 with the New Orleans Saints activating Jordyn Tyson, Kelvin Banks
stories.detail: The big story heading into the Cleveland Browns matchup with the New Orleans Saints is the visiting team’s quarterback position. Shedeur Sanders will start , but Deshaun Watson has cleared concussion protocol and could be set to be the backup, after missing practice all week. On the other side, the home Saints are coming off their bye week, made a position coach change , and the final injury report provided hope that WR Jordyn Tyson and OT Kelvin Banks Jr. could return from injured reserve. Tyson, New Orleans’ first-round pick, has not played at all this season with a hamstring injury. Banks was the Saints’ first-round pick last season and started all 17 games for the team as a rookie in 2025, but went on injured reserve after two games this season. Saturday afternoon, New Orleans officially activated both Tyson and Banks off injured reserve, along with four other moves: Waived RB Kendre Miller Waived TE Treyton Welch Elevated K Charlie Smyth Elevated RB Zamir White Given Tyson’s injury history in college, it will be interesting how much playing time he is allowed in Week 9 against the Browns, while Banks is likely to take back over at left tackle.

stories.title: Maryland football survives late scare in 34-29 victory over Purdue
stories.summary: The Terps scored 27 second-half points in their come-from-behind victory.
stories.detail: The University of Maryland Men’s Football Team was defeated by University of Illinois 20-17 at SECU Stadium on October 31th 2026. | Jessie Reider/Testudo Times With Purdue down to a fourth-and-10 from their own 5-yard line and 44 seconds remaining, it appeared Maryland football’s first Big Ten victory in 14 games was secured. But the Boilermakers weren’t done. “They don’t make it easy on me, man,” interim head coach Aazaar Abdul-Rahim joked of his defense after the game. Purdue found a completion to extend its two-minute drill, and it kept moving downfield, arriving at Maryland’s 11-yard line with five seconds left. But an illegal substitution pushed the offense back, giving Maryland’s pass rush more time to deliver. And as quarterback Ryan Browne scrambled, Zion Elee spun him around, with Sidney Stewart delivering the leveling hit as time expired. The Terps held on to beat the Boilermakers, 34-29, for their first Big Ten win in 413 days. The matchup between teams that each have just two Big Ten wins over the last three seasons looked the part early, with the Terps and the Boilermakers combining for 69 first-quarter yards. teamStories.summary: 49ers and Raiders head coaches linked since 1994 as the family times run deep between the Shanahan’s and Kubiak’s
teamStories.detail: (Photo by Ethan Miller/Getty Images) | Getty Images Want to a crystal clear example of the kind of football team Klint Kubiak wants his Las Vegas Raiders to become? Eye the San Francisco 49ers very closely this Sunday. Because when Kubiak’s Raiders head to Santa Clara to go toe-to-to with Shanahan’s Niners, you’ll get a bird’s eye view a San Francisco team that plays complementary football and is 6-1 overall because of it. There have been fleeting moments of this for Las Vegas, however, the inability to harness consistency is a big reason why the team is 4-4 overall. Curious as to why Shanahan’s football team is one to model for Kubiak? The pair of head coaches are steeped in the game, thanks to the coaching connection between their fathers Mike Shanahan and Gary Kubiak. The Kyle and Klint dynamic goes back to 1994 when Mike was the offensive coordinator and Gary the quarterbacks coach of the 49ers Super Bowl-winning coaching staff. The elder Shanahan and Kubiak continued to be tied at the hip with the Denver Broncos. “Not a first one. LAPD officers responded to a call at 9:39 p.m. Friday to investigate a possible burglary on James' property, the spokesperson said. A suspect was apprehended at the residence, taken into custody and booked for stalking, the spokesperson said. James was in Cleveland on Friday night for his Philadelphia 76ers ' game against the Cavaliers . The Sixers lost 119-95 to his former team. A representative for James had no comment about the incident.

stories.title: Den Questions: Finding Identity In Turmoil
stories.summary: Ten games in the Wolves have burned bright, weathered losses, and still have questions to answer.
stories.detail: Welcome back to the Den. The Wolves are ten games in and their record stands at 7-3. Over that time the Wolves sprinted out of the gates, lost Anthony Edwards to dirty knees in need of a cleaning, and have mostly righted the ship. Their losses are on travel back-to-backs and their first game without Edwards where they didn’t even have a chance to practice before tip-off. This team found something special in their first four games and then had their literal knees cut from them. Through the mire of the early season, as the rest of the league reels from their own injuries, the Wolves are looking for another new identity. An identity that does not include Edwards but prepares for his return. As you can imagine, there are a lot of questions for this team to answer. Here are some of them. Note: So much of this is small sample size theater. 1. Can Jonathan Kuminga keep this up? It’s just flashes. He had similar highs in Golden State before cooling down.
